# formlift

> Open-source TypeScript library (MIT) that turns any PDF into a fillable web form. It keeps the original PDF and puts real form fields on top of it. No AI and no server-side conversion.

- Auto-detects fields (answer lines, checkboxes, blanks, table cells) from the PDF's vector drawing
- Drag-and-drop builder, 20 field types, conditional logic, follow-up questions, comments, validation
- Fill-in UI for desktop and phone; exports a completed PDF with answers, signatures and attachments
- React components (`formlift/react`), a framework-free custom element for Angular / Vue / plain JS (`formlift/element`), a headless core (`formlift`) and server helpers (`formlift/server`)
- Install: `npm install formlift`
